fields.name: live game state
fields.meaning: The game keeps its whole current state here while playing (the chip doubles as main memory). Saving copies these bytes as they are into a save slot; loading copies them back. Same layout as the slot rows below (offset 0000 here = offset 4004 in slot 1)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0277 (power-on: stack and data segment set to the chip, 0000-3fff filled with ff), 4000:006f (save copies from 0000), 4000:0128 (load copies to 0000); recomputed: slot 1 data equals 0000-0cf1 in every valid save

fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Scratch memory and stack used while playing; never saved
fields.evidence: code 4000:0277 (stack top 4000); diff: changes on almost every play step, never copied by the save routine

fields.name: slot 1 signature
fields.meaning: Text LANG, copied from the start of the program. A slot without it is shown as empty (no data)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0095 (written), 4000:0100 (checked); boot read trace pc 4000:010a

fields.name: scenario number
fields.meaning: Scenario the save belongs to; the load list shows it as Scenario N continued. 1 on a new game
fields.evidence: code 4000:490b (new game sets 1), 4000:08c2 (story script sets it), 4000:7c34 (status screen); verified save value 1, load list shows Scenario 1

fields.name: turn counter
fields.meaning: Battle turn number. Set to 0 when a scenario battle is set up, +1 each turn (2000 wraps to 1000). ffff = not set yet. On load, a non-zero value resumes the battle instead of the preparation menu
fields.evidence: code 4000:4d79 (set 0), 4000:3615 (+1, wrap 7d0->3e8), 4000:0ef4 (story trigger), 4000:01f7 (load resume); diff ffff->0000 at battle setup

fields.name: option 1
fields.meaning: On/off setting from the options menu; picks a message/wait speed value (1 or 4)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0044 (options menu flips 0003+cursor), 4000:286c; 0 in all saves seen

fields.name: option 2
fields.meaning: On/off setting from the options menu; skips a display step when set (exact meaning not checked)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0044, 4000:6297; 0 in all saves seen

fields.name: music off
fields.meaning: Options menu: 1 = background music off
fields.evidence: code 4000:0054 and 4000:77d2 (music not started when set); 4000:02c1 clears at power-on

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money in units of 10 (100 = 1000P shown). Capped at 9999
fields.evidence: code 4000:4910 (new game 100), 4000:25ba (add, cap 270f), 4000:25cd (spend, floor 0), 4000:545a (shop check); diffs 100->88 equipment buy (880P), 100->82 hire 3 pike (820P), 82->70 hire 3 soldiers (700P)

fields.name: hero creation result
fields.meaning: Values set during the opening question sequence (observed 02 01 02 01 01 00 00); they also seed the hero record stats bytes +20/+21
fields.evidence: diff at the character-creation screen (hero shown as Fighter); sortie record +20/+21 set to 02 02 at the same time

fields.name: item count
fields.meaning: Number of items held (max 64)
fields.evidence: code 4000:6d1c (full at 0x40, +1 on add), 4000:6d54 (-1 on remove), 4000:5453 (shop refuses when full); diff 0->1 on first item

fields.name: item list
fields.meaning: Items held, kept sorted by id; ffff = empty. 64 entries of 2 bytes: item id, then a second byte (ff when newly added; 01 seen on the held item, probably an owner/status value). Only entries with second byte ff can be removed
fields.evidence: code 4000:48fb (new game fills ff), 4000:6d1c (sorted insert of id,ff, stride 2), 4000:6d54 (remove needs sub=ff); diff first entry ff ff -> 01 01

fields.name: event flags
fields.meaning: 1024 story/event flags, one bit each: flag n is bit (n mod 16) of the word at +((n/16)*2)
fields.evidence: code 4000:25f9/2601/2609/2611 (test/set/flip/clear) + 4000:261c index math; diff cleared ff->00 after the opening quiz

fields.name: battle tally list
fields.meaning: Up to 32 entries of 7 bytes, one per commander taking part: status flags, character id, defeat counter (starts 0), mercenary type, mercenary count, map-unit byte 1, sortie byte +1b
fields.evidence: code 4000:6495 (each byte source), 4000:6475 (built from sortie records with +1c bit7), 4000:643f (counter update); diff 6 entries appear at battle setup

fields.name: battle tally count
fields.meaning: Number of entries in the battle tally list

fields.name: character roster
fields.meaning: 22 character records of 58 bytes (id first: 1 Shion, 2 Tiana...; last slot empty). Same layout as the sortie table; records move between the two when commanders are placed
fields.evidence: code 4000:712b (clears 22), 4000:72a1/72cc/73a5 (58-byte copies); commander screen matches ids/levels

fields.name: sortie table: character id
fields.meaning: First of 12 sortie records of 58 bytes: the commanders and guests of the current scenario. Byte 0 = character id (1 Shion, 2 Tiana, 3 Rukman in the verified save)
fields.evidence: code 4000:7153 (clears 12), 4000:647d; values match the commander list screen

fields.name: character record: class
fields.meaning: Class id (record +3): 83 = Fighter, 86 = Royal Guard
fields.evidence: commander screen: Shion Fighter / Tiana Royal Guard match 83/86

fields.name: sortie record: mercenary type
fields.meaning: Type of mercenary hired for this commander (record +16): 1 soldier (40P), 7 pike (60P)
fields.evidence: code 4000:72e8/73ad (cleared), 4000:649f (copied to tally); diff 0->7 hiring pike for Shion, 0->1 hiring soldiers for Tiana; hire list screen prices

fields.name: sortie record: mercenary count
fields.meaning: Number of mercenaries hired for this commander (record +17)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0cc7 (set, capped), 4000:72eb; diff 0->3 (screen x3) for both hires

fields.name: sortie record: unit pointer
fields.meaning: Address of this commander's map unit in the unit table (record +18)
fields.evidence: code 4000:64b6 (followed to read unit byte 1); values step by 13 into the unit table

fields.name: character record: has item
fields.meaning: Record +24: 1 on the commander holding the item, else 0
fields.evidence: diff 00->01 on the hero record when the first item was obtained; only that record is 1

fields.name: sortie record: status flags
fields.meaning: Record +28: bit 7 = record takes part in the battle
fields.evidence: code 4000:6483 (tally skips without it), 72a8, 73a5

fields.name: character record: level
fields.meaning: Commander level (record +36); matches the commander screen
fields.evidence: screens: Shion LV1/Tiana LV10 match values 1/10; other records hold 1-10, empty slot ff

fields.name: character record: equipped item
fields.meaning: Equipped item id (record +37), 0 = none
fields.evidence: diff 00->01 on the hero record when item 01 was obtained; all other records 0

fields.name: sortie record: other fields
fields.meaning: Rest of each 58-byte record (+4..+15 stats/setup, +20..+23, +25..+27 stat bytes, +38..+57 unused zeros) not decoded
fields.evidence: compared across 22 roster records; patterns noted but no screen/code link

fields.name: map unit table
fields.meaning: 65 map units of 13 bytes (commander and mercenary pieces; byte 1 is copied into the tally). Full layout not decoded
fields.evidence: code 4000:3117/3361/45a7 (walk from 09a5), 4000:64b6 (byte 1 read); entries link to sortie records

fields.name: slot 1 checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the 3314 data bytes 4004-4cf5 (signature not included)
fields.evidence: code 4000:00a8 (computed on save), 4000:0119 (checked); recomputed over 16 valid saves, all match

fields.name: slot 2
fields.meaning: Second save slot: LANG + first 1773 bytes of the game state (header, items, flags, tally, roster; no sortie or map units) + 16-bit sum. Written by a separate save routine; the screen that offers it was not reached (empty in all saves here)
fields.evidence: code 4000:025b (load list checks it), e000:aeb6 (save picks slot 2/3), table at e000:b0d5; boot read trace reads it as empty

fields.name: slot 3
fields.meaning: Third save slot, same layout as slot 2
fields.evidence: code 4000:026d, e000:aec0; boot read trace reads it as empty

fields.name: backup copy
fields.meaning: Second copy of 4000-5add (all three slots), written right after the first. At load, a slot whose sum fails is repaired from the other copy
fields.evidence: code 4000:008c (+1ade write), 4000:00b4 (check both, copy good over bad); identical in every valid save

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: diff all saves zero; outside any save routine range

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not used by this game
fields.evidence: diff identical across all saves
